verdicts.claim: Context 262,144 native, extensible to 1,000,000 with static YaRN factor 4.0 via --hf-overrides, with a warning about short-text quality

Supported by chat_template.jinja. Lines 46-49 default reasoning_effort to 'xhigh' and raise an exception on any other value. Line 118 gates on preserve_thinking. The generation prompt ends with '<think>

</think>

' when enable_thinking is false. README lines 258-264 say the same.
